name: damascus steel
lore_descriptor: patterned with wave-grain in the polished steel
first_pickup_chronicle: Damascus. Pattern-welded steel — folded a hundred times by smiths whose names are lost. The wave-grain in the metal is a signature: this was made with patience.
design_notes: Fills pf 28 gap. Premium steel. Slight crit bonus. Magical-friendly (max_enchant 4) — its forging process leaves the metal receptive to enchantment.
